import (
	"context"
	"os"
)

type Input struct{}

type Output struct {
	WorkingDirectory string `json:"working_directory"`
}

func Invoke(_ context.Context, _ Input) (ToolResponse[Output], error) {
	directory, err := os.Getwd()
	if err != nil {
		return ToolResponse[Output]{}, err
	}
	return ToolResponse[Output]{Accepted: true, Output: &Output{WorkingDirectory: directory}}, nil
}
